candidates.description: handleMonarchEndStepDraw implements "at the beginning of the monarch's end
candidates.doc:
handleMonarchEndStepDraw implements "at the beginning of the monarch's end
step, that player draws a card" (Rule 718.3). firePhaseEvents fires
EventEndStep once per turn with ev.Player set to the ACTIVE player (whose
end step is occurring, see StepEnd in firePhaseEvents) — so this only
draws when the active player IS the current monarch, never for the other
player's end step.
candidates.name: handleMonarchEndStepDraw
candidates.title: handleMonarchEndStepDraw

resolution.excerpt:
963 	case "cards_drawn_this_turn":
  964 		// "X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn[, minus one]"
  965 		// (Proft's Eidetic Memory class, ticket
  966 		// engine.auto-cards-drawn-this-turn-counter-amount-830d3199d7).
  967 		// Player.CardsDrawnThisTurn already accumulates every draw this
  968 		// turn (handleTrackCardsDrawn, gamestate.go) and resets each turn,
  969 		// so this is a direct read; the generic "minus"/"plus" offset in
  970 		// EvalDynamicAmountFull above handles "... minus one".
  971 		return who(str(spec, "whose")).CardsDrawnThisTurn, true
resolution.name: cards_drawn_this_turn
